---
title: "UK-US deal? Not so fast!"
description: "The UK is squeezed from both sides: Trump tariffs are hitting US-bound exports even after the Economic Prosperity Deal, while Brexit-era TCA friction keeps taxing trade with the EU."
date: "2025-06-12"
categories: [brexit, trade-wars]
---

Trump's tariffs have driven the largest monthly fall in US exports on record (data back to January 1997), and the UK's Economic Prosperity Deal with Washington hasn't spared exporters from 25% car tariffs and a 10% general surcharge. Meanwhile, Trade and Cooperation Agreement frictions continue to weigh on UK-EU trade, so the UK is absorbing costs on both its largest trading relationships at once. The piece argues the more reliable fix is closer to home: renegotiating the TCA and deepening EU ties, rather than banking on an unpredictable US partner.

**Originally published on Substack**, June 12, 2025.
